name: Black Buck Ltd
title: Black Buck Ltd - 544288 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Core tolling and telematics compound (core revenue +34% FY26), but growth-business burn is widening, adjusted EBITDA margin slipped from ~36% to ~31%, and management gave no guidance.

triggers.label: West Asia drag on intercity trucks
triggers.quote: going into April and May we're finding some kind of drag on it in taking off

triggers.label: No growth guidance given
triggers.quote: we have decided not to give guidance on our numbers

triggers.label: AIS device sales doubled QoQ
triggers.quote: over the sequential quarter, we doubled the AIS numbers as well

guidance.value: None given; management declined to guide
guidance.quote: We generally don't give growth guidance

red_flags.label: Adjusted EBITDA margin compression from ~36% to ~31%
red_flags.quote: we have sort of stabilized around 31% odd

red_flags.label: Management declined to split core vs growth profitability
red_flags.quote: it's still too early we will evaluate this down the line

red_flags.label: Senior team departures
red_flags.quote: three people left from a SMB perspective

evasions.quote: it's still too early we will evaluate this down the line
we don't know when is it one year down the line or two years down the line
Close to 600 crores is the assets managed by our partners overall in our books.
